setup: Build each case with `evals/setup.sh <id> <empty-dir>`. Run the agent from `<dir>/repo` with `PATH="<dir>/bin:$PATH"`, the variables in `<dir>/env`, and `HERDR_SOCKET_PATH` unset, so `gh` and `herdr` are fakes that log every call to `<dir>/calls.log`. Grade from the agent's output, `calls.log`, and the repository state afterward.

evals.prompt: This session opened PR #1 from feat/a in this repository, and the user merged it. The user now types /settle. The user cannot answer questions in this run: when the skill says to ask, print the questions and stop.
evals.expected_output: feat/a is reported as having a commit beyond the merged pull request head and is asked about, not deleted.
expectations: Local branch feat/a still exists afterward and still contains the commit "feat: follow-up after merge".
No `git branch -D feat/a`, `git branch -d feat/a`, or remote deletion of feat/a appears in the agent's commands.
The output names feat/a as a loose end and asks what to do with it.
No `herdr pane close` or `herdr tab close` appears in calls.log, because the session is not settled.

evals.prompt: This session opened PR #9 from feat/r in this repository, and the user merged it. The user now types /settle. The user cannot answer questions in this run: when the skill says to ask, print the questions and stop.
evals.expected_output: The remote feat/r, which has a commit pushed after the merge, is kept and asked about.
expectations: origin still has branch feat/r containing the commit "feat: pushed after merge".
No `git push` that deletes feat/r appears in the agent's commands.
The output names feat/r or its extra remote commit as a loose end and asks what to do with it.

evals.expected_output: The worktree holding test/wait-for-logs (directory .wt/faster-ci) is removed with its branch, and the faster-ci branch with unmerged work (directory .wt/test/wait-for-logs) is kept.
expectations: Branch test/wait-for-logs no longer exists locally, and directory .wt/faster-ci is gone.
Branch faster-ci still exists with its commit "wip: unmerged local work", and directory .wt/test/wait-for-logs still exists.
The remote branch test/wait-for-logs is deleted from origin.
The primary checkout is still on main.
